name: @minhduydev/pi-learning
description: Append-only project-local learning ledger for Pi with two separate trust gates: manual human approval, and a bounded auto-safe machine gate that is on by default in Pi-trusted projects. Selective fork of Matt Devy's pi-continuous-learning.
